items.claim: He uses striking and takedown feints effectively to force inactivity from opponents and control the range.
items.quote: he has a good mix of both striking and takedown faints. And when he when he uses those, he forces inactivity out of his opponents.

items.claim: His striking defense statistics remain very high even when including the first Volkanovski fight.
items.quote: even if you leave that one in, his striking defense is still very high on the stats.

items.claim: He possesses good accurate combinations incorporating kicks and excels at counter-striking opponents as they step in.
items.quote: He's got good accurate combinations he can put together often including the kicks, and he can also counter strike very well.

items.claim: He is the best grappler in the UFC with near-perfect takedown entries.
items.quote: He is an excellent grappler. In fact, I think he's the best grappler in the UFC. He's got near perfect takedown entries

items.claim: He frequently transitions from single-leg attempts to inside trips to secure half guard.
items.quote: a lot of times he'll go in for like a single leg, and then he'll switch it to the inside trip, and that's where he ends up in half guard

items.claim: He uses submission feints to safely advance position and control opponents on the ground.
items.quote: when he's work looking to advance position, he's going to make you think that he's going for a submission. And when he goes when he when he faints that submission, then he takes the next spot.

items.claim: He has great takedown defense and excels at scrambles.
items.quote: He's got great takedown defense as well. He can scramble extremely well

items.claim: His predominant submission weapons are the D'Arce and the head and arm choke.
items.quote: since then it's been the D'Arce and that and the arm triangle or the head and arm choke. Those are the things that he uses predominantly
